tools.name: get_program_info
tools.description: Overview of Desert Road Catholic: what it is, cost (free), 2027 dates, the six stages, what registration includes, and key links. Example: "Tell me about Desert Road Catholic."

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: Get the date, Exodus reading, stage and opening prayer for one of the 90 days. Pass a day number (1-90) or a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). With neither, uses today's date in US Eastern time. Example: "What is today's Exodus 90 reading?"

tools.name: list_stages
tools.description: The six stages of the 90 days, with their days, start dates, opening prayers and every day's Exodus reading. Example: "What are the six stages of Exodus 90?"

tools.name: get_prayer
tools.description: Full text of a traditional Catholic prayer from the site's Armory, such as the stage prayers (Come Holy Spirit, guardian angel, St. Michael, Memorare, Anima Christi, Te Deum), the Rosary mysteries by day, prayers in temptation or the daily examen. Example: "Give me the Memorare."

tools.description: The four sets of Rosary mysteries (Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious, Luminous) with the days each is prayed, all twenty mysteries with their fruits and Douay-Rheims scripture, the order of prayers for a full Rosary, and the free guided Rosary link and data file. tools.name: register
tools.description: Register a man for the free daily companion. ONLY call this when the user has explicitly asked to register and has given their own email address in this conversation; never guess or reuse an address. Ask whether he is leading a fraternity if he hasn't said. He will get a welcome email from hello@des

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register · Private data: list_rosary_mysteries · Public sink: register.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register · Private data: list_rosary_mysteries · Public sink: register

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
